why_ai: Technicians install and repair alarm, fire and access systems on site under state alarm licences and NICET and AHJ rules, while the monitoring half is screen work that automation erodes.
why_clarity: Codes, UL 827 action plans and service scripts define most tasks and signals recur by the million, but whether an alarm was real is rarely confirmed.
why_digital: Buildings and devices are the input and the install is physical, while monitoring is delivered remotely, and customers buy from local dealers.

why_ai: In-home installs and the relationship protect some of the work, but DIY systems and platform automation are steadily taking the install and the monitoring call.
why_clarity: Contracts, attrition and arming behaviour are measured precisely across millions of near-identical accounts, with cancellations giving a fast outcome.
why_digital: Devices go into homes, but monitoring, apps and much of the selling run digitally.

why_ai: Designing and installing site-specific access and video systems is hands-on, licensed work sold through long client relationships.
why_clarity: Specifications define the install, but every site differs and service quality is judged slowly at renewal.
why_digital: Specifications and device data are digital, while the install and service are physical and bought through local or regional bids.

why_ai: Synchronising cardholders and door permissions with HR and identity systems is rules work that identity software absorbs once connected.
why_clarity: A badge either matches the HR record or it does not, across thousands of daily joiner, mover and leaver changes.
why_digital: HR records and access logs in, permission changes and review reports out, though the doors and the integrator relationship are local.

why_ai: Hundreds of sites still need technicians to repair cameras, panels and readers on site, even as health monitoring automates.
why_clarity: Device health and SLA compliance are objective, checkable states repeated across every site in the estate.
why_digital: Telemetry and tickets are digital, but the service delivered is a physical site visit, bought through national programmes.

why_ai: Two-person crews physically test every device under NFPA 72, NICET credentials and AHJ enforcement, and the code keeps requiring it.
why_clarity: Test frequencies and pass or fail criteria are codified device by device, and each test result is immediate.
why_digital: The work is physical testing in buildings, delivered as reports to local owners and fire marshals.

why_ai: Tracking permits, allowances and fines across ordinances is document and rules work software can do entirely.
why_clarity: Each account is permitted and dispatchable under its ordinance or it is not, checked against city records.
why_digital: Ordinances, permits and fine notices are documents handled online, with local city portals the only constraint.

why_ai: Owner-operators install and service systems for customers who know them, and sell a book whose value rests on those relationships.
why_clarity: Installs and monitoring are routine, but the business decisions that set the book's value are judged at sale, years later.
why_digital: Physical installs in a local territory, sold face to face and by referral.

why_ai: Talking a frightened older adult through a fall and choosing the responder needs a trusted, accountable person, though detection automates.
why_clarity: Event handling follows scripts at volume, but whether a response was right is rarely followed up.
why_digital: Device signals and calls are digital, the device sits in the home, and payers buy through regional contracts.

why_ai: Verifying camera events is screen work that AI filtering is absorbing, with the operator's talk-down and police call the protected remainder.
why_clarity: Each event is real or not and thousands recur per shift, though outcomes after dispatch return slowly.
why_digital: Video in, verified events and talk-downs out, delivered remotely from monitoring centres.

why_ai: Clearing power-loss and low-battery troubles is the most routine signal work in the industry and automation takes it directly.
why_clarity: Each trouble restores or needs a ticket, with timestamps giving instant, objective feedback across millions of signals.
why_digital: Signals in, notifications and tickets out, all inside software, with stations chosen by dealers remotely.

why_ai: Survey reports and forecasts are research work AI drafting and synthetic panels increasingly substitute.
why_clarity: Annual trackers recur on defined questions, but forecasts are judged years later and methods differ by firm.
why_digital: Surveys in, reports out, sold online to remote buyers.

why_ai: Device analytics and in-product insights are software features, protected mainly by the installed dealer base.
why_clarity: Device events and engagement metrics are exact and computed continuously across millions of properties.
why_digital: Telemetry in, software features and reports out, sold to dealers across North America.

why_ai: Pricing and demand analytics on transaction data are automatable, with the purchase record the main protection.
why_clarity: Forecasts and quote prices are checked quickly against orders and wins.
why_digital: Transaction data modelled on screen, with insight sold to manufacturers through account relationships.

why_ai: Device-to-claims analysis is desk work on data, though underwriting accountability and partner deals stay with people.
why_clarity: Claims outcomes give measurable results, but slowly, and programme designs vary by carrier.
why_digital: Enrolment and claims data analysed on screen, with programmes run through partners and agents.

why_ai: Scoring submitted accounts is repeatable underwriting software can largely do, with dealer audits the judgement left.
why_clarity: Thousands of near-identical accounts are scored against set criteria and chargebacks show results within a year.
why_digital: Account files reviewed on screen, with dealers recruited and audited through relationships.

why_ai: Acquisition judgement and seller relationships decide deals that AI does not originate.
why_clarity: Each acquisition is bespoke and whether it created value is known years later.
why_digital: Deal analysis is on screen, but sourcing runs through owner relationships.

why_ai: Sellers hire a trusted adviser to run a negotiated private sale, which AI does not replace.
why_clarity: Valuation methods exist but each sale is bespoke and outcomes are private.
why_digital: Valuations are on screen, with deals run through industry relationships.

why_ai: Lenders carry credit risk on dealer character and book quality, judged through long relationships.
why_clarity: Borrowing-base tests are structured, but defaults reveal underwriting errors years later.
why_digital: Borrower reports analysed on screen, with loans originated through industry relationships.

why_ai: Matching dispatches to permits and issuing invoices is clerical work software performs directly.
why_clarity: Each invoice follows the ordinance's fine schedule exactly, across thousands of identical cases.
why_digital: Dispatch records in, invoices out, run digitally for cities that award contracts locally.

why_ai: Signal-handling software faces AI-native competitors, though UL-listed installed bases are sticky.
why_clarity: Platform behaviour is specified and testable, with releases recurring across many stations.
why_digital: Software in, software out, sold to stations across North America.

why_ai: Collecting and checking inspection reports is document work AI extraction does directly.
why_clarity: Each report is complete and compliant with the jurisdiction's rules or it is not, at high volume.
why_digital: Reports in, compliance dashboards out, adopted jurisdiction by jurisdiction.

why_ai: AHJs and insurers require listings and certificates from on-site audits by an accountable certifier.
why_clarity: Audits check stations against written UL 827 requirements with clear pass or fail.
why_digital: Audits happen on site, while certificates and verification are delivered online nationwide.

why_ai: Statutory authority over police response cannot be substituted, though the record-keeping automates.
why_clarity: Ordinance rules and dispatch counts are codified and recur daily.
why_digital: Dispatch records are digital, but each unit acts within its own jurisdiction with no choice of provider.

why_ai: Associations persist on member relationships, standards authority and police negotiations more than on analysis.
why_clarity: Standards and model ordinances are revised by committee consensus rather than objective checks.
why_digital: Standards and reports are produced digitally, with conferences and police negotiations in person.
